detail.title: Dahua 5MP Spot Detection Camera
detail.overview: Favourite ITC514-PH6D-Q20-F28-POE Dahua 5MP Spot Detection Camera Key Points High Sensitivity and Clarity: HD 5MP camera with 1/2.7"" CMOS, suitable for environment with low illumination Advanced Multi-Spot Detection: 2 lenses provide surround detection with up to 99.5% recognition accuracy. Supports two parking zones and two parking lanes, simultaneously detecting up to 12 parking spaces (6+6 standard spaces or 4+4 spaces with LPR), delivering comprehensive coverage and precise monitoring. Smart Event Analysis: Intelligent detection of parking space status, such as illegal parking, smoke detection, line crossing detection and parking in restricted areas. Easy deployment: Network wiring with easy connection, installation, and maintenance. Robust Connectivity: 1 RS-485 for external indicators, 1 × RJ-45 Ethernet Port, H.264, H.265, and MJPEG flexible coding, PoE power supply and 12–48 VDC. Built-in LED: 7 indicator lights colors, adjustable according to parking space type (charging spaces, handicapped spaces, etc.). Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Basic.Max.Detection Spot: Parking space detection:12 Parking space detection+ License Plate recognition: 8
Basic.Indicator Light: 1, 7 customizable colors (red, yellow, blue, green, cyan, white, and pink)
Basic.Image Resolution: 2880 (H) × 1620 (V) (OSD black background is not calculated in the pixels)
Basic.White Balance: Auto; Outdoor; Partial white balance; Manual; Natural; Street lamp
Basic.Video Frame Rate: PAL: Main stream (1920 × 1080@25 fps, 1280 × 720@25 fps), sub stream (704 × 576@25 fps)
Basic.Exposure Mode: Auto; Manual (Select from shutter values or customize shutter range)
Basic.Field of View: Channel 1(Parking Space): H: 108.4°; V: 60°; D: 127.1° Channel 2(Parking Space): H: 108.4°; V: 60°; D: 127.1°
Basic.Lens Angle: Vertical adjustable (depression angle of 43°–0°) Horizontal adjustable (from left 20° to right 20 °) 20° clockwise to 20° counterclockwise
Basic.Security: Username and password authorization; MAC address binding; HTTPS encryption; IEEE 802.1x; network access control
Basic.OSD Overlay: Time; address; parking space No.; parking space status; plate number; vehicle model; vehicle logo and color
Basic.Alarm Event: Illegal access, security error and other events
Basic.Image Tampering Prevention: Yes. Watermarks can be added to videos and images for verification.
Basic.Voice Broadcast: Voice broadcast (adjustable volume and customizable content)
Basic.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile S & Profile G & Profile T); CGI; ITSAPI
Basic.Vehicle Recognition: In the recommended installation and lighting condition, recognizes vehicle model, logo, color, and plate number, and collects metadata for unlicensed vehicles. Vehicle recognition rate is over 99.5%, and the recognition rate for European vehicle plates is over 98% .
Basic.Illegal Parking Detection: Detects illegal parking events including vehicle occupying two parking spaces, non-allowlist vehicle occupying a parking space, small vehicle parked in a large vehicle's space and parking in a restricted area.
Basic.Non-motor Vehicle Detection: Supports the detection of non-motor vehicle occupancy.
Basic.Unauthorized Occupation: Detects non-motor vehicles, traffic cones, shopping carts and no parking signs.
Basic.Network Port: 1 × RJ-45 Ethernet port, 100/1000 Mbps network transmission
Basic.Power Output: 12 VDC ± 10% voltage output, ≤ 0.4 A current output
Basic.Focal Length: Channel 1(Parking Space): 2.8 mm; Channel 2(Parking Space): 2.8 mm
